description: Natural placement of the dinle_2 vocal lines on the new song form (no pitch or time processing: cut, raised-cosine fades, integer-sample shifts only)
not_verified_by_ear: Everything here is measured by code; nobody listened to the result.

schema.time_base: src_* = seconds on the timeline of dinle_2_vokal.wav; dest_* = seconds on the timeline of vokal_dogal.wav (bar 0 starts at 0.0)
schema.form: bars are 0-based; verse v (0..6) starts at bar 4 + 8*v; bar downbeat time = bar * bar_sec

lines[].dest_bar_downbeat: time of the bar line the line belongs to
lines[].offset_used_sec: dest_onset - dest_bar_downbeat (= the line's own measured offset from the tempo analysis, up to half a sample of rounding); negative = the first sound starts before the bar line
lines[].src_onset / dest_onset: acoustic onset of the first syllable (tempo analysis definition, includes initial consonants)
lines[].src_in/src_out, dest_in/dest_out: extent of the line's audio including fades; inside the L3+L4 chunk the L3|L4 boundary is the junction between the two lines
lines[].src_sound_start/end: energy onset / decay of the sung line from the segmentation (10 ms RMS crossing sung_rms - 45 dB)
lines[].shift_sec: dest time - src time for this line's audio (constant inside a line except verse 6 line 2, see its syllables and repairs)
lines[].src_verse: verse the audio was taken from (differs from 'verse' only for the reused verse-6 line 4)

lines[].syllables[].src_start/src_end, dest_start/dest_end: contiguous tiling of the line (segmentation boundaries shifted to the destination)
lines[].syllables[].dest_vowel_onset: beat-alignment point of the syllable; vowel_onset_beats_in_bar = (dest_vowel_onset - dest_bar_downbeat) / beat
lines[].syllables[].midi: ORIGINAL sung pitch: median f0 of the vowel core (segmentation f0_midi); midi_all_voiced = median over all voiced frames of the syllable
lines[].syllables[].src_line: where the syllable's audio comes from
lines[].syllables[].boundary_flag: true = a boundary of this syllable was placed by rule in the segmentation (çift-li-ği / Çift-li-ğin-de)

schema.chunks[]: the 21 placed pieces of audio ([L1], [L2], [L3+L4] per verse) with their fades; fade_*.leak/loss = energy admitted from beyond the cut point / removed from the line's own side by the fade, as equivalent RMS over 10 ms
schema.repairs[]: edits other than plain cutting and shifting

audio.silence: exact digital zero outside the placed chunks
audio.processing: cut + raised-cosine fades + integer-sample shift; one global gain; no pitch shift, no time stretch, no resampling

placement_rule.how: each line's own bar line (tempo.json lines[].downbeat, a point of the constant 116.015 BPM machine grid) is mapped onto the destination bar line: dest_time = dest_bar_downbeat + (src_time - src_downbeat), rounded to whole samples
placement_rule.why: the tempo analysis rates the grid as high confidence (phase deviation at most 1.7 ms) and all 28 lines as on-the-beat; mapping bar line to bar line reproduces each line's measured offset exactly and does not depend on the onset detector, so no onset-detection noise enters the placement. The per-line-number median offset was therefore not used.
placement_rule.l3_l4: L3+L4 is one chunk anchored on L3's bar line; L4 lands on the next bar line because the source tempo equals the destination tempo (bar-to-bar difference at most 0.1 ms, from the 4-decimal rounding of the downbeats)
placement_rule.fades: chunk edges: 15-30 ms raised cosine. Where the quiet gap between two sung lines is wider than 15 ms the fade lies inside it; where the gap is narrower the 15 ms fade is centred on the gap (see chunks[].fade_*.rule and leak/loss)

repairs.what: sung 'ördekleri' replaced by 'köpek' (from verse 6 line 3 'Köpekler') + the original /k/ burst + 'leri'

de_fade_out.note: 'de' ran straight into 'ör' (vowel to vowel); its vowel is faded out here to form the /k/ closure

timing.note: everything from the /k/ burst of 'leri' on ('leri var') is untouched and stays at its original position, so 'var' is exactly in time
timing.de_note: 'de' is shorter than sung (was 140 ms up to the 'ö'; now about 79 ms of sound + closure) because the inserted /k/ closure + burst + aspiration need about 60 ms before the vowel

pitch.note: 'kö' was sung on D4 (it is the first syllable of line 3), about 1.9 semitones below the E4 around it. NOT corrected here (no pitch processing in this step).

word_duration.note: measured from the first sound of the word (old: vowel 'ö'; new: /k/ burst, 47 ms before its vowel) to the end of 'ri'; the vowel onsets coincide within 0.2 ms

repairs.what: verse 6 line 4 (its last 'bak' ends on D4) replaced by verse 1 line 4 (same words, ends on C4)
repairs.position: the donor's own bar line (downbeat 12.4197) is put on verse 6 line 4's bar line (downbeat 80.1695): the donor keeps the metric position it had in its own verse

crossfade.note: verse 6's line 3 is kept up to the lowest point of its final /r/ murmur (just before its own /d/ burst); the donor enters inside its voiced /d/ closure, 15.3 ms after the donor's own L3|L4 junction (12.3779), so nothing of the donor's line 3 is included

level.note: no per-line gain was applied (task rule: one global gain only); the mixer may apply the suggested gain to this line if wanted

repairs.type: trim (NOT in the task's repair list; defect reported by the segmentation)
repairs.what: the voiced after-sound that follows the last 'bak' after a silent gap (41.3879-41.5895 s, MIDI 58.59, peak -19.3 dBFS; not part of the lyric) is dropped
repairs.why: in the new form it would start 6 ms after the downbeat of bar 6 of the verse, i.e. on top of the first animal call
repairs.consequence: the final 'bak' ends in an unreleased /k/ (the closure silence is kept for 71 ms, then faded); verse 2's 'bak' also ends without a release
